Message.Name: Time Reference Message
Message.Description: C1 Options Only. The Time Reference message is used to provide a midnight reference point for recipients of the feed. It is sent whenever the system starts up and when the system crosses a midnight boundary. All subsequent Time messages for the same unit will use the last Midnight Reference until another Time Reference message is received for that unit. The Time Reference message includes the Trade Date, so most other sequenced messages will not include that information. Time Reference messages will be included in a spin response.

Field.Name: Midnight Reference
Field.Description: Midnight Eastern Time reference time for subsequent Time messages, expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds. On Daylight Saving Time transition days, Time reflects wall clock seconds and does not adjust for the UTC offset change.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Current Trade Date.

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a PITCH event for a given clock second. If there is no PITCH event for a given clock second, then no Time message is sent for that second. All subsequent time offset fields for the same unit will use the new Time value as the base until another Time message is received for the same unit. On C1 only, the Time message will also include the Epoch Time field, which is the current time represented as the number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970).

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Field.Name: Epoch Time
Field.Description: C1 Options Only. Number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe complex book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. For Equities only, this message will be sent at startup each day. It would also be distributed in certain recovery events such as a data center fail-over.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Transaction Begin Message
Message.Description: The Transaction Begin message indicates any subsequent messages, up to the accompanying Transaction End message, are all part of the same transaction block. All PITCH messages corresponding to such an event would be included between a Transaction Begin and Transaction End. Any PITCH Message Type may be included in a transaction block and there is no guarantee that the messages apply to the same price level or even the same Symbol. Transaction Begin messages do not alter the book and can be ignored if messages are being used solely to build a book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Transaction End Message
Message.Description: The Transaction End message indicates that a transaction indicated by a previous Transaction Begin message has completed. Transaction End messages do not alter the book and can be ignored if messages are being used solely to build a book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Complex Instrument Definition Expanded Message
Message.Description: A Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message represents a complex instrument that is available to place orders. It is sent as a sequenced message the first time a Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message is sent for a symbol. These messages will also be sent continuously through the day as an unsequenced message (sequence = 0) at variable rates as bandwidth allows. The Time offset field should be ignored on an unsequenced Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message. The Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message will contain two or more repeating groups of leg definitions. There is a limit of 16 leg definitions, one of which may be an equity leg.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Type
Field.Description: 4 character field; each field describes a characteristic. Character 1: Complex Option Type. O = All legs are options, E = One leg is an equity leg. Characters 2-4: Reserved.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 16.

Field.Name: Complex Leg
Field.Description: Repeating group of leg definitions, repeats Leg Count times.

Message.Name: Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: C1 Options Only. The Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition (EDCID) message represents supplemental information associated with an exchange-designated complex instrument and is sent as a sequenced message the first time it is sent. These messages are also sent continuously throughout the day as an unsequenced message (sequence = 0) at variable rates as bandwidth allows. The Time offset field should be ignored on unsequenced EDCID messages. This message is sent in addition to a Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message for each exchange-designated complex instrument. The EDCID message contains two or more repeating groups of leg definitions. There is a limit of 16 leg definitions.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: EDCI Type
Field.Description: Exchange Designated Complex Instrument type right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: EDCI Subtype
Field.Description: Exchange Designated Complex Instrument subtype right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 16.

Field.Name: EDCID Leg
Field.Description: Repeating group of leg definitions, repeats Leg Count times.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol and Underlying. These messages are not sequenced (sequence = 0) and are sent continuously through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces. All spaces if not available or not applicable.

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe complex book. It includes a day-specific Order Id assigned by Cboe to the complex order.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity added to the complex book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Short message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe complex book whose Price fits in a Binary Signed Short Price and Quantity fits in an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity being added to the complex book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Add Order Expanded Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Expanded message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe complex book and carries additional attribution fields (Participant ID, Customer Indicator, Client ID).

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity being added to the complex book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Participant ID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified the Executing Broker of firm attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: N = Non-Customer, C = Customer.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: Reserved Filler
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible complex order on the Cboe complex book is executed in whole or in part. The execution price equals the limit order price found in the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: See Options Trade Condition Codes for details.

Message.Name: Order Executed at Price Size Message
Message.Description: Order Execution at Price/Size messages are sent when a complex order on the Cboe complex book is executed in whole or in part at a different price than the limit price on the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id. If the Remaining Quantity field contains a 0 the complex order should be completely removed from the complex book. Order Execution at Price/Size messages may also be sent in the event the existing size for Order Id is not equal to Executed Quantity + Remaining Quantity. In this case the complex order should be prioritized the same as a new complex order.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity executed.

Field.Name: Remaining Quantity
Field.Description: Number of contracts remaining after the execution.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: See Options Trade Condition Codes for details.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a complex order on the Cboe complex book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity canceled.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size Short messages are sent when a complex order on the Cboe complex book is partially reduced and the canceled quantity fits in an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity canceled.

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open complex order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. Note that Modify Order messages that appear to be "no ops" (i.e. they do not appear to modify any relevant fields) will still lose priority.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity associated with this complex order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order Short message is sent whenever an open complex order is visibly modified and both the new price and quantity fit in short fields.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity associated with this complex order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever a booked order is cancelled or leaves the order book. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. An order that is deleted from the book may return to the book later under certain circumstances. Therefore, a Delete Order message does not indicate that a given Order Id will not be sent again on a subsequent Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been removed from order book.

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of complex order auctions on the Cboe complex book. A Trade message can also be sent when an auction executes against a non-displayed order, such as a contra response. Trade messages are necessary to calculate Cboe execution-based data. Trade messages do not alter the complex book and can be ignored if messages are being used solely to build a complex book. No Add Order message is sent for complex auction orders, and thus, no order modification messages may be sent when complex auctions are executed. Instead, a Trade message is sent whenever a complex auction is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B=Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: See Options Trade Condition Codes for details.

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade Short message is the short-price/short-quantity variant of the Trade message, used when both the execution price and quantity fit in short fields.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B=Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: See Options Trade Condition Codes for details.

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of a complex auction. Auctions will be available for a defined period of time known as the exposure period.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Notification Auction Type
Field.Description: C = Complex Order Auction (COA) (or Stop Complex Order Auction (SCOA) effective TBD), S = Complex Solicitation Auction Mechanism, B = Complex AIM, O = COA All or None.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B = Buy, S = Sell.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price. The price field will be populated for all Auctions on EDGX Options, and for SAM Auctions on C1. This field will reflect the auction start price for SPX and SPXW AIM (C1 Only) and will be set to zero for all other AIM on C1. This field will be set to zero for COA on C1, C2, and BZX Options.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: N = Non-Customer, C = Customer.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this quote.

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancelation of an earlier Auction Notification message as a result of a user cancelation of the original complex auction, a user modification request to change the complex auction price or increase the original complex auction quantity, a fading of the NBBO or to cancel any remaining complex auction quantity from the original Auction Notification following the complex auction termination. A user request to modify the complex auction price or to increase the original complex auction quantity will result in a cancelation of the complex auction followed by a new Auction Notification message. Auction Cancel messages will not be issued for complex auction quantity decrements.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from a complex auction.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a complex instrument. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever a complex instrument trading status changes. The Trading Status field will be used to represent the status of the RTH (9:30 a.m. ET - 4:15 p.m. ET) and Curb sessions. The GTH Trading Status field will be used to represent the status of series that trade during the GTH session (C1 Only). The GTH session runs from 8:15 p.m. to 9:25 a.m. ET for SPX and VIX series (C1 only).

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Symbol ID
Field.Description: Complex Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: H = Halted, L = Curb Trading (C1 Only), Q = Quote-Only, T = RTH Trading.

Field.Name: Reserved Filler
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: GTH Trading Status
Field.Description: C1 Only. H = Halted, Q = Quote-Only, T = Trading.

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Options Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Options Auction Update messages are used to disseminate price and size information during the Opening and Re-Opening (halt) process for complex instruments. The Options Auction Update messages are sent every 5 seconds during an opening period.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 Only), O = RTH Opening (C1 Only), H = Halt Re-Opening.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Buy Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Buy interest at the Indicative Price.

Field.Name: Sell Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Sell interest at the Indicative Price.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: SNBBO Collared Volume Maximizing Imbalance Minimizing Price computed on combined Auction-Only and Continuous Book (if any).

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Composite Market Bid Price
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Composite Market Offer Price
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction of a complex instrument. An Opening or Re-Opening Auction Summary message for each complex instrument is sent at the conclusion of its Opening or Re-Opening auction and represents Cboe opening price.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: G = GTH Opening (C1 Only), O = RTH Opening (C1 Only), H = Halt Re-Opening.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Cumulative instrument quantity executed during the auction.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Group.Name: Complex Leg
Group.Description: Repeating leg definition group inside the Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message. Repeats Leg Count times.

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Option or Equity Symbol of leg, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side). For options this is the number of contracts, for equities this is the number of shares.

Field.Name: Leg Security Type
Field.Description: O = Leg is an Option instrument, E = Leg is an Equity instrument.

Group.Name: EDCID Leg
Group.Description: Repeating leg definition group inside the Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition message. Repeats Leg Count times.

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Option symbol of leg, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side).
